imageid.description: ID of the image. Read-only; required for update operations.

imagetype.description: Type of image. Possible values: 1 - (default) icon; 2 - background image. This property is constant and cannot be changed after creation.

image.description: Base64 encoded image. The maximum size of the encoded image is 1 MB. Maximum size can be adjusted by changing the ZBX_MAX_IMAGE_SIZE constant value. Supported image formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP.
